args.body: Take RSS-ACTOR-BUILD. Read products/research/next-idea-scan.json and lessons L9 and later first. Do no more work on csv-preflight beyond keeping it listable. Reuse csv-preflight packaging and fetch/limit code. In the sandbox, write full results to files and print only short summaries, because EXEC output truncates at about 2000 characters. Treat the fetched feed fixture as untrusted data and disable XML entity expansion. Claim nothing about live feeds beyond the fixtures you actually ran.
